 COSRX Drives Mainstream K-Beauty Growth, Targeting 2,000 Australian Stores
 By PR Newswire
 November 20, 2026
 10
 Resize 
 Small 
 Medium 
 Large 
 Global Friendly Derma skincare brand expands through Coles, Kmart and Target, bringing bestselling peptide innovations to more Australian shoppers from mid-November. SYDNEY , Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- COSRX, the globally recognised Korean derma skincare brand, is expanding its retail network to approximately 2,000 stores across Australia, strengthening its position as a leading brand driving the mainstream adoption of K-beauty.
 COSRX Expands Retail Network to Approximately 2,000 Stores Across Australia, Leading the Mainstream Adoption of K-Beauty

 Building on its established presence in the Australian market, COSRX is extending its reach across major pharmacies, supermarkets and discount department stores, making globally successful Korean skincare more accessible to everyday Australian shoppers. Expanding COSRX's Retail Presence Across Australia 
 COSRX products are already sold through more than 350 Chemist Warehouse stores and BIG W. On 25 September 2026, the brand expanded into Coles as part of the supermarket chain's nationwide skincare rollout across more than 850 stores and online.
 Advertisement 
 The brand is now further expanding its distribution through Kmart and Target, with a planned rollout across approximately 480 stores.
 Together with its existing retail partners and other sales channels, COSRX's nationwide retail network is set to reach approximately 2,000 stores, bringing Korean skincare closer to Australian consumers through their everyday shopping destinations.
 Where to Buy COSRX in Australia 
 Australian consumers can find selected COSRX products through Chemist Warehouse, BIG W and Coles, with an expanded range expected to reach Kmart and Target store shelves from mid-November 2026.
 Advertisement 
 Chemist Warehouse: An established retail partner with COSRX available across more than 350 stores. Selected products include the bestselling Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence .
 BIG W: An existing COSRX stockist offering products including Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence , Advanced Snail 92 All In One Cream and Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser.
 Coles: COSRX launched on 25 September 2026, with selected products including Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence, Advanced Snail 92 All In One Cream, Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser and BHA Blackhead Power Liquid. See the official Coles announcement .
 Kmart and Target: The planned product range includes The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum , The Peptide Collagen Hydrogel Eye Patch, Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence, hydrating skin-booster products, blemish patches, cleansers, vitamin C serums and retinol products. Selected products are expected to become available on in-store shelves from mid-November 2026, subject to individual store rollout schedules.
 Product availability may vary by retailer and location. Consumers are encouraged to check individual retailer websites for participating stores and the latest product availability. K-Beauty Goes Mainstream in Australia 
 K-beauty is increasingly moving beyond specialist beauty retailers and into everyday Australian shopping destinations.
 In a 7NEWS article published on 10 September 2026 , the outlet highlighted the growing mainstream appeal of Korean skincare and its expansion across major Australian retailers.
 Advertisement 
 Similarly, Coles Group's official announcement on 14 September 2026 highlighted the rising popularity of K-beauty, citing more than 40 billion global TikTok views of K-beauty-related content over a four-month period, based on TikTok Creative Centre data.
 With its established global reputation and expanding Australian retail network, COSRX is helping bring ingredient-focused Korean skincare into the mainstream, creating more opportunities for consumers to discover effective skincare products as part of their everyday routines.
 From Global Bestsellers to Peptide Innovation 
 COSRX's Australian expansion builds on its longstanding success in global skincare markets, including its iconic Advanced Snail range and high-performance The RX collection.
 Advertisement 
 The brand has built a strong global digital presence, with more than one million social media followers and 9.3 billion cumulative views of COSRX-related TikTok content, according to company figures.
 Key products include: 
 Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence 
 One of COSRX's most iconic global bestsellers, this lightweight essence is formulated with 96% snail secretion filtrate to provide lasting hydration, support the skin's moisture barrier and help skin look more even-toned and smoother in texture. It leaves dry or dull-looking skin feeling comfortable and hydrated, with a healthy-looking glow.
 Advertisement 
 Official Product Details 
 The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum 
 A lightweight, first-step booster powered by six peptides, designed to address multiple cosmetic skin concerns in one formula - including the look of enlarged pores, visible oiliness, uneven texture, fine lines and loss of firmness. Its fast-absorbing, toner-like texture hydrates and leaves skin feeling firmer and more supple, with a smoother, more radiant appearance, while preparing it for the rest of the skincare routine.
 The serum ranked No. 1 in Olive Young's Essence & Serum category on 1 July 2025, followed by No. 1 in its Skincare category on 1 July 2026 in South Korea, according to company sales records.
 Advertisement 
 Australian consumers are expected to find the serum in Kmart and Target stores from mid-November 2026.
 Official Product Details 
 The Peptide Collagen Hydrogel Eye Patch 
 Formulated with four peptides, low-molecular-weight collagen, caffeine, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid, these hydrogel eye patches provide soothing hydration for the delicate under-eye area. They help the skin feel comfortable and supple while leaving the eye area looking smoother and refreshed.
 The product achieved No. 1 rankings in Amazon US's Eye Mask category during the 2025 Black Friday-Cyber Monday period and 11-20 April 2026, as well as in TikTok Shop US's Eye Treatment category, according to COSRX's sales records.
 The eye patches are also included in the planned Kmart and Target assortment.
 Official Product Details 
 The Blue Peptide Bakuchiol Plump Glow Serum 
 Powered by 0.5% Copper Peptide and 0.25% Bakuchiol, this multi-action serum helps skin look smoother and firmer, with a more refined-looking texture and visibly radiant finish. Its lightweight formula provides plumping hydration for a supple, bouncy-looking, glass-like glow.
 The serum ranked No. 1 in Olive Young's Skincare category in South Korea and Qoo10 Japan's Skincare category in May 2026, according to company records. The product is planned for a future Australian launch.
 Official Product Details 
 Strengthening K-Beauty Leadership Through Friendly Derma 
 COSRX's growing Australian retail network reflects its Friendly Derma philosophy: making high-performance, ingredient-focused skincare accessible at affordable prices.
 Through its expanding partnerships and globally recognised skincare innovations, COSRX aims to help more Australians incorporate effective derma skincare into everyday routines while strengthening its presence in the growing K-beauty market.
 A COSRX spokesperson said: 
 "Our peptide skincare range has already demonstrated its strength with consumers in South Korea and the United States, and we're pleased to make these innovations more accessible to Australian shoppers.
 "Guided by our Friendly Derma philosophy, we aim to bring high-performance skincare at accessible prices into everyday routines. By working closely with our retail partners, we'll continue bringing COSRX closer to Australian consumers and supporting the mainstream growth of K-beauty."
 Black Friday Offers at Coles, BIG W and Kmart 
 Australian shoppers can explore selected COSRX products during upcoming Black Friday promotions: 50% off at Coles (18-23 November), 30% off at BIG W (19-26 November) and 20% off at Kmart (23-30 November 2026). Offers are subject to participating products, stores, stock availability and each retailer's terms; check directly with retailers for details.
 About COSRX 
 COSRX is a global Korean derma skincare brand recognised for its Friendly Derma philosophy, combining ingredient-focused innovation with effective, accessible skincare solutions.
 Known for its iconic Advanced Snail range and high-performance The RX collection, COSRX develops skincare products designed to address everyday skin concerns, including dryness, uneven skin texture, visible pores and loss of firmness.
 In Australia, COSRX products are available through leading retail partners including Chemist Warehouse, BIG W and Coles, with the expansion across Kmart and Target.
 For more information, visit www.cosrx.com .
